name: Maid-san Daisakusen
source:
You play Ijyuin Tadanori who is a man happens to acquire a special ticket which allows you to be the master of Rokumeikan (Maid training institution) for a day.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ028565.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
